foodName: Cooked Basmati Rice (freshly prepared, warm)
visualObservations: Steaming white rice, fluffy grains, separate, no discoloration, normal pleasant aroma
notes: Safe for prompt donation and distribution within 4-6 hours at ambient temperature.

foodName: Cooked Rice (stored at room temperature 18h)
visualObservations: Slightly glossy/slimy film on top, faint sour odor, grains clumping together
notes: High risk: Bacillus cereus heat-stable emetic toxin develops rapidly at room temperature. Visual inspection alone fails to detect invisible bacterial proliferation.

foodName: Pasteurized Milk (freshly opened, chilled)
visualObservations: Uniform white liquid, smooth pouring, fresh mild dairy scent, no curdling or skin
notes: Optimal freshness for distribution.

foodName: Pasteurized Milk (soured with small curd specks)
visualObservations: Small white curds visible on rim, slightly separated whey, sour acidic odor
notes: Correctly detected by AI based on visible curdling.

foodName: Sliced White Sandwich Bread (unopened fresh loaf)
visualObservations: Soft springy crumb, golden crust, no mold, pleasant yeasty aroma
notes: Standard commercial sandwich bread.

foodName: Sliced Sandwich Bread (early blue-green mold specks)
visualObservations: Small (2-3mm) circular green/fuzzy mold spots on crust and two inner slices
notes: Mold mycelium penetrates porous bread deeply; whole loaf must be discarded.

foodName: Ripe Cavendish Banana (yellow with small brown sugar spots)
visualObservations: Bright yellow peel with moderate freckling/brown spots, firm neck, sweet fragrant odor
notes: Optimal eating ripeness; high sugar content, ideal for immediate redistribution.

foodName: Overripe Banana (black peel, liquid seepage)
visualObservations: Entirely blackened peel, mushy liquid consistency inside, fermented alcohol odor
notes: Fermentation indicates yeast/bacterial spoilage beyond table use.

foodName: Fresh Baby Spinach Leaves (crisp, vibrant green)
visualObservations: Crisp upright leaves, bright dark green, dry surfaces, no slime or yellowing
notes: Excellent condition.

foodName: Baby Spinach (wet, translucent dark green slimy leaves)
visualObservations: Leaves broken down into dark brownish-green slime, liquid pooling at container bottom, pungent rotting smell
notes: Bacterial soft rot. Entire package contaminated.

foodName: Raw Chicken Breast (freshly butchered, pink)
visualObservations: Firm moist pink flesh, translucent sheen, neutral odor, clear juices
notes: Raw poultry requires strict temperature controls (< 4°C).

foodName: Raw Chicken Breast (gray-green hue with tacky surface)
visualObservations: Dull grayish-pink surface, tacky viscous slime, noticeable pungent sulfur/ammonia odor
notes: Pseudomonas spoilage. High risk of foodborne pathogen proliferation.

foodName: Cooked Chicken Biryani (refrigerated 24h in sealed container)
visualObservations: Firm chicken pieces, distinct rice grains, fragrant spices, no surface drying or condensation mould
notes: Safe if reheated thoroughly to > 74°C before consumption.

foodName: Cooked Lentil Dal (room temperature 14h)
visualObservations: Fine surface bubbles/froth, slight sour smell, thinning consistency
notes: Fermentation bubbles in dal indicate active bacterial growth at tropical temperatures. AI vision can miss subtle froth without close-up inspection.

foodName: Fresh Whole Fuji Apple
visualObservations: Smooth taut red skin, firm to squeeze, intact stem, sweet fresh aroma
notes: Excellent shelf life for food bank distribution.

foodName: Apple with brown internal rot around core (externally bruised)
visualObservations: Soft sunken brown bruise on one cheek, skin wrinkled, spongy when pressed
notes: External bruise looks severe to visual model, but flesh can be trimmed and fruit is still edible. AI over-penalized cosmetic bruising.

foodName: Fresh Cottage Cheese / Paneer (blocks in brine)
visualObservations: Firm white blocks, clean edges, milky mild scent, brine is clear
notes: High protein food, ideal for distribution.

foodName: Paneer with yellowish surface and slimy coating
visualObservations: Yellowish greasy slime on block surface, sour rancid odor, cloudy discolored brine
notes: Rancidity and bacterial surface slime.

foodName: Fresh Tomatoes (firm, glossy red vine tomatoes)
visualObservations: Taut glossy red skin, green calyx attached, firm texture, pleasant earthy tomato smell
notes: Peak freshness.

foodName: Tomato with split skin and white mold filaments
visualObservations: Deep split with white fuzzy mold growing in fissure, skin collapsed and weeping juice
notes: Clear mold sporulation.

foodName: Freshly Cooked Pasta with Marinara Sauce
visualObservations: Warm pasta, vibrant red tomato sauce, aromatic basil and garlic, tender bite
notes: Suitable for immediate hot delivery.

foodName: Pasta with Marinara (left in pot at room temp for 24h)
visualObservations: Sauce has darkened to brownish-red, crusty dry top layer, acidic sharp fermented smell
notes: Dried sauce layer masks internal bacterial colonization. AI predicts Moderate based on visible sauce color, missing the thermal danger zone violation.

foodName: Whole Grain Sourdough Loaf (day 3)
visualObservations: Crust somewhat hard/chewy, interior crumb slightly dry but no mold, characteristic sour aroma
notes: Stale but completely safe for consumption, toasting, or bread pudding.

foodName: Fresh Strawberries (bright red, green caps)
visualObservations: Plump shiny berries, intact seeds, green calyx, no soft spots or mold fuzz
notes: High perishable value fruit.

foodName: Strawberries with Botrytis cinerea gray mold
visualObservations: Thick velvet-like gray fuzz covering 3 berries, neighboring berries weeping fluid and collapsing
notes: Botrytis sporulates rapidly; entire punnet must be rejected.
